title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.22355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. translated_title: OmniVerifier-C1：面向规则约束生成式世界建模的分解式分级验证器
translated_abstract: 生成式视觉验证器在推动多模态智能发展方面发挥着关键作用。为了增强视觉验证器在涉及组合性要求的复杂多模态场景中的鲁棒性，我们超越了仅产生真/假离散判断的传统二值验证器，提出了一种能够自动将复杂提示或环境规则分解为细粒度组件并逐项打分的验证器，从而提供连续且更具信息量的评判信号。我们的实验进一步证明，这些结构化且可解释的输出提升了验证器在域外多模态评判任务上的泛化能力。为了训练该验证器，我们引入了一种解耦强化学习训练策略，联合优化子问题级别的二值判断与全局对齐评分，利用精确的局部反馈培养细粒度验证能力，为可靠的协同（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）奠定基础。
tldr: 该论文提出OmniVerifier-C1，通过将复杂提示或环境规则自动分解为细粒度组件并逐项连续打分，结合解耦强化学习策略联合优化子问题二值判断与全局对齐评分，显著提升了视觉验证器在复杂多模态场景下的鲁棒性和域外泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OmniVerifier-C1, a decomposed graded verifier that automatically breaks down complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components with pointwise continuous scores, trained via a Decoupled RL strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, significantly improving robustness and out-of-domain generalization of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios.
